title: City of Laredo Housing Services Now Online Through RentCafe
excerpt: The City of Laredo Municipal Housing Department now offers its housing services online through RentCafe, letting tenants pay rent, submit maintenance requests and check their account status from anywhere.
content:
The City of Laredo Municipal Housing Department is moving its housing services online through RentCafe, the city announced Monday morning.

Through the online platform, Municipal Housing tenants can pay rent online, submit maintenance requests, and check their account status and payment history, according to the city.

Residents who are not current tenants can also use RentCafe to complete and submit rental applications online, according to the city.

RentCafe is available at RentCafe.com and as an app on Apple and Android devices, according to the city. For more information, residents can contact the City of Laredo Municipal Housing Department.

Source: City of Laredo - Government, November 16, 2026.
